mapper.select: SELECT ct.ct_name AS carName, c.cr_thumbnail AS thumbnail, c.cr_year AS cr_year, c.cr_fuel_type AS cr_fuel_type, c.cr_trans AS cr_trans, stats.min_price AS minPrice, stats.max_price AS maxPrice FROM car c JOIN car_type ct ON c.cr_ct_key = ct.ct_key JOIN rental r ON c.cr_re_num = r.re_num JOIN region reg ON r.re_rg_num = reg.rg_num JOIN ( SELECT cr_ct_key, rg_name, MIN(cr_price) AS min_price, MAX(cr_price) AS max_price FROM car JOIN rental ON cr_re_num = re_num JOIN region ON re_rg_num = rg_num GROUP BY cr_ct_key, rg_name ) stats ON c.cr_ct_key = stats.cr_ct_key AND reg.rg_name = stats.rg_name WHERE c.cr_ct_key = #{ct_key} AND reg.rg_name = #{rg_name} ORDER BY c.cr_price ASC LIMIT 1

select car.*, ct_name, count(rr_num) as reservation_count from car join car_type on ct_key = cr_ct_key join rental on re_num = cr_re_num join region on rg_num = re_rg_num join car_package on cp_cr_id = cr_id join re_reservation on rr_cp_num = cp_num where rg_num = #{rg_num} group by cr_id order by reservation_count desc limit 7;

SELECT c.*, ct.ct_name, ct.ct_type, c.cr_thumbnail, r.re_name, reg.rg_name FROM car c JOIN car_type ct ON c.cr_ct_key = ct.ct_key JOIN rental r ON c.cr_re_num = r.re_num JOIN region reg ON r.re_rg_num = reg.rg_num WHERE c.cr_id = #{cr_id}
select car.*,ct_name from car join car_type on ct_key = cr_ct_key join rental on re_num = cr_re_num join region on rg_num = re_rg_num where rg_num = #{rg_num} order by cr_price limit 7;
select car.*,ct_name,ct_type,re_name from car join car_type on ct_key = cr_ct_key join rental on re_num = cr_re_num where cr_id = #{cr_id}
mapper.insert: insert into car(cr_year, cr_fuel_type, cr_trans, cr_price, cr_count, cr_re_num, cr_ct_key, cr_thumbnail) value(#{cr_year}, #{cr_fuel_type}, #{cr_trans}, #{cr_price}, #{cr_count}, #{cr_re_num}, #{cr_ct_key}, #{thumbString})
